t: This is Liverpool Street station, a major railway terminus in the north-eastern corner of the City of London. Trains run from here to Cambridge, Ely and Norwich, and the Stansted Express leaves for the airport. It's also a London Underground station and a London Overground stop. The station is linked to the 7 July 2005 London bombings. Shehzad Tanweer, one of four men who detonated explosives on the Underground and a bus, died here. Fifty-two people were killed in those attacks, and over 700 were wounded. It's a place to pause and remember them.
